_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Shemot 30, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And make an altar for burning incense, of acacia wood shall you make it.
translations.2: Its length a cubit, and its breadth a cubit — and let it be square — and its height two cubits; its horns shall be from it.
translations.3: And overlay it with pure gold — its top and its walls all around, and its horns — and make for it a rim of gold all around.
translations.4: And two rings of gold shall you make for it below its rim, on its two sides — thus on both its sides — they shall be places for the poles, by which it is carried.
translations.5: And make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
translations.6: And set it before the curtain that is upon the ark of the testimony, before the cover that is upon the testimony, where I shall present Myself to you there.
translations.7: And Aaron shall burn incense upon it — from the incense of resins — every morning; when he tends the lamp, he shall burn incense with it.
translations.8: And likewise when he lights the lamp between the two times of sunset, he shall burn incense with it — a continual burning of incense before God, for your generations.
translations.9: You shall not burn upon it any strange incense, nor a burnt-offering, nor a gift-offering; and a libation you shall not pour upon it.
translations.10: And Aaron shall seek atonement at its horns once a year, from the blood of the sacrifice of the Day of Atonement; once a year he shall seek atonement at it for your generations — it is of the choicest of holy things, belonging to God.
translations.11: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.
translations.12: When you have tallied the total of the sons of Israel by their number, each man shall give a ransom for himself to God when you count them, so that no plague shall befall them at that time.
translations.13: This is what every one who passes through the count shall give: half a mithqal, by the mithqal of the sanctuary — twenty daniqs to the mithqal — half of it is a contribution to God.
translations.14: Every one who passes through the count, from twenty years of age and upward, shall give a contribution to God.
translations.15: The well-off shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than half a mithqal — so give a contribution to God, and make atonement for yourselves.
translations.16: And take the silver of atonement from the sons of Israel, and direct it to the service of the tent of assembly; and it shall be for the sons of Israel a remembrance before God, and an atonement for yourselves.
translations.17: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.
translations.18: And make a basin of copper, and its base of copper, for washing; and set it between the tent of assembly and the altar, and put water in it.
translations.19: And Aaron and his sons shall wash from it — their hands and their feet.
translations.20: Upon their entry into the tent of assembly, they shall wash with water and shall not perish; and upon their approach to the altar to draw near and burn an offering to God,
translations.21: they shall wash their hands and their feet and shall not perish. And this shall be for them an ordinance forever — for him and his sons, for their generations.
translations.22: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.
translations.23: And you — take for yourself the choicest of spices: of pure musk, five hundred mithqals; and of fragrant aloeswood, half of it — two hundred and fifty mithqals; and of aromatic reed, two hundred and fifty;
translations.24: and of costus, five hundred mithqals, by the mithqal of the sanctuary; and of olive oil, a full qist.
translations.25: And make of these the holy anointing oil — a perfumed blend, the craft of a perfumer; thus shall it be the holy anointing oil.
translations.26: And anoint with it the tent of assembly, and the ark of the testimony,
translations.27: and the table and all its vessels, and the lampstand and its vessels, and the altar of incense,
translations.28: and the altar of burnt-offering and all its vessels, and the basin and its base.
translations.29: And consecrate them, that they may be Mine — of the choicest of holy things; whoever approaches them shall be consecrated.
translations.30: And anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may serve as imāms for Me.
translations.31: And instruct the sons of Israel, saying: this shall be for you the holy anointing oil, for your generations.
translations.32: Upon the body of any person it shall not be applied; and in its composition you shall not make anything like it — and as it is consecrated, so shall it be holy to you.
translations.33: Any person who perfumes himself with the like of it, or puts any of it upon a stranger, shall be cut off from his people.
translations.34: And God said to Moses: 'Take for yourself resins — among them: balsam-wood, fragrant nail-shells, and liquid storax — resins together with pure frankincense, in equal parts.
translations.35: And make of these an incense — a perfume, the craft of a perfumer — finely cut, pure, and consecrated.
translations.36: And you shall grind some of it fine, and place it beside the testimony in the tent of assembly, where I shall present Myself to you there; and it shall be for you of the choicest of holy things.
translations.37: And the incense which you make — in its composition you shall not make any like it for yourselves; it shall be holy to you, just as it is for God.
translations.38: Any person who makes the like of it in order to perfume himself with it shall be cut off from his people.'
